title: Modus tollens puzzle
prompt: If it is raining, Sam brings an umbrella. Sam did not bring an umbrella today. Is it raining? Explain your reasoning.

metadata.notes: Correct answer: No. By modus tollens, since bringing an umbrella is required if it's raining, and Sam did not bring one, it cannot be raining. Converted from manual to exact_match (2026-09-23, V2.6 evaluation-coverage pass).
metadata.evaluator_risk: 'No' is a very common word - the word-boundary token matcher could false-positive on an unrelated 'no' elsewhere in a longer explanation (e.g. 'there is no ambiguity here') even if the model's actual conclusion was wrong. Not fixed here; flagged for awareness when reading results.
